target.title: fix(gateway): cap history when numeric limit is huge
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users requesting Gateway HTTP session history with an all-digit `limit` value above JavaScript's safe integer range would receive the minimum one-message page instead of the endpoint's bounded maximum history window.

## Why This Change Was Made

The direct REST history query parser now keeps non-digit limits on the existing minimum fallback while capping all-digit values that exceed safe integer parsing to the existing `MAX_SESSION_HISTORY_LIMIT`. This stays inside the Gateway HTTP history boundary and does not change cursor pagination, SSE streaming, RPC schemas, or configuration.

## User Impact

Gateway HTTP history callers that pass a very large numeric limit get a bounded useful page instead of unexpectedly truncating the response to one message.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: direct REST `/sessions/:sessionKey/history` caps an all-digit limit above the safe integer range to the endpoint's bounded maximum instead of treating it as `1`.
- Current head: `d27121efce282d386fb73f04e7c2be9a5e2add02`.
- Direct Gateway HTTP proof: `node --import tsx --input-type=module -` started `src/gateway/server.ts`, seeded a file-backed session transcript with three assistant messages, and fetched the production `GET /sessions/:sessionKey/history` HTTP route with a 100-digit `limit`.

```json
{
  "head": "d27121efce282d386fb73f04e7c2be9a5e2add02",
  "proofPath": "production src/gateway/server.ts -> GET /sessions/:sessionKey/history",
  "request": {
    "method": "GET",
    "path": "/sessions/agent%3Amain%3Amain/history?limit=9999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999",
    "header": "x-openclaw-scopes: operator.read"
  },
  "response": {
    "status": 200,
    "sessionKey": "agent:main:main",
    "messageCount": 3,
    "texts": [
      "first message",
      "second message",
      "third message"
    ],
    "hasMore": false,
    "nextCursorPresent": false
  }
}
```

- Focused regression test: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/sessions-history-http.test.ts` passed with 1 file and 21 tests.
- Formatting: `node_modules\.bin\oxfmt.CMD --check --threads=1 src\gateway\sessions-history-http.ts src\gateway\sessions-history-http.test.ts` passed.
- Committed diff hygiene: `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode local` completed with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Observed result: the 100-digit `limit` query returned all three seeded history messages with `hasMore: false` and no cursor, instead of falling back to a one-message page.

AI-assisted: yes. I reviewed the Gateway HTTP history parser, direct HTTP proof, and regression test and understand the bounded limit fix.
